'''Sarapin''' was a [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] world in the [[Sarapin system/Legends|Sarapin system]], between [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and the [[Treskov system]]. It had ashy soil and streams of [[Magma/Legends|lava]] flowing across its surface.

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], an independent [[Space station/Legends|space station]] existed in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of Sarapin and stored resources on it. The space station made an emergency call and then went entirely silent.<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Distressed Space Station}}</ref>

The Republic held large operations with the intention of harnessing the power of its many active volcanoes and lava flows. Its [[Sarapin drilling platform|laser drills]] were an impressive sight, reaching a height of forty meters. The energy was tapped by [[energy collector]]s and moved to an Energy Collection Repository, for eventual shipment off-world. [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] estimated that during the later years of the Republic, Sarapin provided 80 percent of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]' power.

[[File:Decimator_on_Sarapin.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A captured [[Decimator (war machine)|Decimator]] [[Assault on Sarapin|attacks]] the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[energy collector]]s on Sarapin.]]

Sarapin was protected by a near-impenetrable defensive grid, which was broken on only two occasions. The first time was during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], by a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[General/Legends|General]], [[Sev'rance Tann/Legends|Sev'rance Tann]]. The Galactic Republic quickly dispatched General [[Echuu Shen-Jon]] to deal with the ongoing invasion and captured [[Zian Finnis]]. Under Echuu's leadership, the Confederacy was denied control of Sarapin.

The second time Sarapin's defenses were breached was when [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] forces infiltrated Sarapin before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Grand General/Legends|Grand General]] [[Malcor Brashin]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Brenn Tantor]] discovered this by analyzing rebel data from the [[Ruul computer complex]]. They hurried to Sarapin, where Tantor led Imperial forces in their recapture of the energy collectors. After retaking them, Tantor discovered that the rebels had [[Battle of Sarapin (Galactic Civil War)|seized]] a [[Sarapin drilling platform|drilling platform]], which had spiralled out of control. Tantor smashed the rebel positions near the drill until he could get his brother [[Dellis Tantor|Dellis]], an accomplished [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]], into the drill, where he was able to shut it down before it destabilized the area and created destructive [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]].

[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] helped the Empire capture [[Kath Talor]] on Sarapin.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TannShip.jpg|thumb|200px|Sarapin depicted as a ringed planet]]
In the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']] [[Wikipedia:Computer game expansion pack|expansion pack]] to the video game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', the pictures of Sarapin shown in the mission briefings were modified shots of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] as it appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]. As such, Sarapin was depicted with a rocky ring system. However, when the planet made its first appearance in ''[[Star Wars: Force Commander]]'', it was devoid of such rocky rings.

The game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' wrongly names the planet Serapin in the crew-skill description.<ref name="Mission" />
